9906f4c37fed576b.text: We present CustomerSim, an environment and benchmark to evaluate the extent to which Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) can simulate realistic, persona-driven customer behavior in chat-based retail environments. While prior work treats user simulation as surface-level dialog generation, we focus on a model's ability to seek information and make decisions that adhere to customer specifications in multiturn, agentic simulations. CustomerSim consists of a human-curated set of 360 personas over five product categories, alongside a suite of metrics measuring consistency between a customer simulator's actions and its specifications and conversational quality. We find several behavioral gaps across five open and closed-source state-of-the-art models. First, while models produce fluent conversations, they display significantly lower lexical diversity than human shoppers, and open-source models overdisclose their criteria in the opening turn. Second, models tend to be persuaded by sales agent tone and drift from persona specifications. Even the strongest closed-source models, Claude Opus 4.8 and GPT-5.6 Sol, achieves <74% alignment with its persona specifications. To address these limitations, we propose UserGRPO, a multi-turn, multi-objective reinforcement learning recipe optimizing both conversational fluency and decision alignment under persona specifications. UserGRPO raises the decision alignment of the baseline model from 0.417 to 0.652, a gain of 23.5 points, without meaningful cost to conversational quality, and these gains transfer to held-out product categories. We further find that stylistic prompting is the only intervention that makes surface form more human-like, yet it nearly halves persona adherence. Through CustomerSim, we provide a testbed for the community to investigate and improve the adherence of user simulators in goal-oriented settings.
9906f4c37fed576b.abstract_zh:
CustomerSim 是一个评测多模态大语言模型能否在聊天式零售环境中模拟真实顾客行为的环境和基准。与以往把用户模拟当作表层对话生成的工作不同，作者关注模型在多轮、智能体式模拟中主动寻求信息并按顾客规格做决策的能力。基准包含人工整理的 360 个顾客画像，覆盖五个商品类别，并配有一套度量指标，衡量模拟顾客的行为与其规格的一致性以及对话质量。

作者在五个开源和闭源的先进模型上发现了几个行为差距。模型生成的对话很流畅，但词汇多样性明显低于真实购物者，开源模型还会在开场就过度透露自己的购买标准。模型容易被销售智能体的语气说服，偏离画像规格，最强的闭源模型 Claude Opus 4.8 和 GPT-5.6 Sol 的画像符合度也不到 74%。

为解决这些问题，作者提出 UserGRPO，一种多轮、多目标的强化学习训练方案，同时优化对话流畅度和画像约束下的决策对齐。该方法把基线模型的决策对齐从 0.417 提升到 0.652，提高 23.5 个百分点，对话质量没有明显下降，且提升能迁移到未见过的商品类别。作者还发现，风格化提示是唯一能让表面形式更像真人的干预手段，但它会把画像符合度几乎砍半。CustomerSim 为社区提供了一个研究目标导向场景下用户模拟器符合度的测试平台。
9906f4c37fed576b.why: 它给出了一个可直接复用的用户模拟评测基准和指标体系，并展示了大模型顾客模拟器容易被销售话术带偏这一风险，UserGRPO 的训练方案对做智能体仿真的从业者有直接参考价值。

brief.question: 多模态大语言模型（MLLM）能否在聊天式零售环境中模拟真实、符合人设（persona）的顾客行为，尤其是多轮智能体仿真中的信息寻求与决策行为。
brief.setup: CustomerSim 环境包含人工整理的 360 个 persona，覆盖五个商品类别，评估了五个开源和闭源的 SOTA 模型，包括 Claude Opus 4.8 和 GPT-5.6 Sol。
brief.method: 提出指标衡量顾客模拟器行为与 persona 规格的一致性及对话质量；针对发现的缺陷提出 UserGRPO，一种多轮、多目标强化学习训练方案，同时优化对话流畅度和 persona 规格下的决策对齐。
brief.findings: 模型对话流畅但词汇多样性显著低于人类购物者，开源模型在首轮就过度透露购物标准；模型会被销售智能体的语气说服、偏离 persona，最强的闭源模型 persona 对齐也不足 74%。UserGRPO 把基线模型的决策对齐从 0.417 提升到 0.652（提高 23.5 个百分点），对话质量基本无损，且提升可迁移到未见过的商品类别。风格化提示（stylistic prompting）是唯一让表面形式更像人的干预，但使 persona 遵循度几乎减半。
brief.validation: 与人类购物者的词汇多样性对比；在 held-out 商品类别上测试 UserGRPO 的迁移效果；对比多种干预（如风格化提示）。未说明具体人类数据规模。
brief.limits: 未说明。
brief.reuse: CustomerSim 作为公开测试环境（360 persona、五类别、一致性指标套件）和 UserGRPO 训练方案可供社区使用。未说明是否开源代码。

997646c103788486.text: Modeling household-level decisions is central to many real-world applications, including trip planning, residential mobility and migration, disaster management, etc. Existing studies primarily rely on classical machine learning models with limited predictive capacity, while recent LLM-based approaches have yet to incorporate behavioral theory or intra-household interaction dynamics, both of which are essential for modeling realistic household decisions. To address these limitations, we propose Persona-Enriched Multi-Agent Negotiation for household Decision-making (PEMAND), a novel LLM-based framework that integrates behavioral theory into individualized, household-aware persona modeling and simulates household-level decision-making through structured multi-agent negotiation. Specifically, PEMAND transforms static sociodemographic attributes into coherent narrative profiles that explicitly encode household-level attitudes, subjective norms, and perceived behavioral controls, following our proposed Household-Aware Chain-of-Planned-Behavior (HA-CoPB) framework. Building on these theory-grounded personas, PEMAND captures real-world household decision negotiation via a structured two-phase multi-agent conversation framework with a novel persona-alignment control mechanism. Evaluated on national and regional household decision datasets across two major domains, including travel behavior and residential mobility, PEMAND consistently outperforms state-of-the-art benchmarks.
997646c103788486.abstract_zh: 家庭层面的决策建模对出行规划、居住迁移、灾害管理等应用很重要。已有研究主要用经典机器学习模型，预测能力有限；近年的大模型方法则没有纳入行为理论，也没有刻画家庭内部的互动，而这两点对模拟真实家庭决策不可少。作者提出 PEMAND 框架。做法分两步：先把静态的社会人口属性转写成连贯的叙事化人格档案，按他们提出的 Household-Aware Chain-of-Planned-Behavior（HA-CoPB）框架，在其中显式编码家庭层面的态度、主观规范和感知行为控制；再基于这些人格，用结构化的两阶段多智能体对话框架模拟家庭决策谈判，并配有一个新的人格对齐控制机制。评估覆盖全国性和区域性家庭决策数据集，涉及出行行为和居住迁移两个领域，PEMAND 在两个领域上都稳定优于当前最强的基准方法。材料没有给出具体的误差数字或消融结果，验证强度和适用边界需要看原文。
997646c103788486.why: 它示范了怎么把计划行为理论这类行为学理论嵌进大模型人格建模，并用多智能体谈判刻画家庭内部协商，这个做法可以直接搬到出行、居住迁移之外的家庭决策仿真里。

brief.question: 如何用 LLM 仿真家庭层面的决策（如出行行为、居住迁移），并纳入行为理论和家庭内部成员间的互动协商，这些是现有经典机器学习模型和已有 LLM 方法都缺失的。
brief.setup: PEMAND 是基于 LLM 的多智能体框架，智能体为家庭中带有个体化 persona 的成员，覆盖出行行为和居住迁移两个领域，使用全国性和区域性家庭决策数据集评测。具体智能体数量、环境、时间尺度和所用 LLM 型号未说明。
brief.method: 提出 Household-Aware Chain-of-Planned-Behavior（HA-CoPB）框架，把静态社会人口属性转成叙事化 persona，显式编码家庭层面的态度、主观规范和感知行为控制；再通过两阶段结构化多智能体对话模拟家庭决策协商，并引入新的 persona 对齐控制机制。
brief.findings: 在出行行为和居住迁移两个领域的全国性与区域性家庭决策数据集上，PEMAND 一致优于 state-of-the-art 基准。具体提升幅度未说明。
brief.validation: 与全国性和区域性家庭决策数据集上的 state-of-the-art 基准对比，PEMAND 一致胜出，但未给出具体误差数字或消融实验细节，强度无法评估。
brief.limits: 未说明。
brief.reuse: HA-CoPB persona 建模方法和两阶段多智能体协商框架可直接借鉴；代码和数据是否公开未说明。

9b9cdf7e34998dbd.text: Service system performance depends on how participants respond to design choices, but modeling these responses is hard due to the complexity of human behavior. We introduce an LLM-powered multi-agent simulation (LLM-MAS) framework for optimizing service operations. We pose the problem as stochastic optimization with decision-dependent uncertainty: design choices are embedded in prompts and shape the distribution of outcomes from interacting LLM-powered agents. By embedding key numerical information in prompts and extracting it from LLM-generated text, we model this uncertainty as a controlled Markov chain. We develop an on-trajectory learning algorithm that, on a single simulation run, simultaneously constructs zeroth-order gradient estimates and updates design parameters to optimize steady-state performance. We also incorporate variance reduction techniques. In a sustainable supply chain application, our method outperforms benchmarks, including blackbox optimization and using LLMs as numerical solvers or as role-playing system designers. A case study on optimal contest design with real behavioral data shows that LLM-MAS is both as a cost-effective evaluator of known designs and an exploratory tool that can uncover strong designs overlooked by traditional approaches.
9b9cdf7e34998dbd.abstract_zh: 服务系统的表现取决于参与者对设计选择的反应，但人类行为的复杂性让这类反应很难建模。作者提出用 LLM 驱动的多智能体仿真（LLM-MAS）来优化服务运营。问题被表述为带决策依赖不确定性的随机优化：设计选择写进提示词，影响相互作用的 LLM 智能体产生的结果分布。具体做法是把关键数值信息嵌入提示词，再从 LLM 生成的文本中提取这些数值，从而把不确定性建模成受控马尔可夫链。在此之上，作者提出一种轨迹上学习算法，在单次仿真运行中同时构造零阶梯度估计并更新设计参数，以优化稳态性能，还加入了方差缩减技术。在可持续供应链应用中，该方法的表现优于多个基准，包括黑箱优化、把 LLM 当数值求解器用、以及让 LLM 角色扮演系统设计者。作者还用真实行为数据做了最优竞赛设计的案例研究，结果显示 LLM-MAS 既可以作为低成本评估已知设计的工具，也能作为探索工具，发现传统方法忽略的强设计。局限方面材料未展开讨论。
9b9cdf7e34998dbd.why: 它把 LLM 智能体仿真和随机优化接在一起，给出了在单次仿真轨迹上边跑边调参数的算法，并用真实行为数据验证，对想用仿真做服务系统设计优化的研究者是可直接借鉴的方法路线。

brief.question: 服务系统的表现取决于参与者对设计选择的反应，但人类行为复杂、难以建模。作者要推演的场景是：给定服务系统的设计参数，参与者（智能体）会如何反应，以及如何据此优化系统表现。
brief.setup: 未说明具体智能体数量、环境细节和时间尺度。框架为 LLM-powered multi-agent simulation（LLM-MAS），智能体由 LLM 驱动，设计选择以数值形式嵌入 prompt，应用场景包括可持续供应链和竞赛设计（contest design）。
brief.method: 把问题表述为带决策依赖不确定性的随机优化：设计选择嵌入 prompt，影响交互 LLM 智能体产生结果的分布。通过在 prompt 中嵌入关键数值信息并从 LLM 生成文本中提取数值，把不确定性建模为受控 Markov 链。提出 on-trajectory learning 算法，在单次仿真运行中同时构造零阶梯度估计并更新设计参数，以优化稳态表现，并加入方差缩减技术。
brief.findings: 在可持续供应链应用中，该方法优于多个基准，包括黑盒优化、把 LLM 当数值求解器、以及让 LLM 扮演系统设计师。在基于真实行为数据的竞赛设计案例中，LLM-MAS 既能作为低成本评估已知设计的工具，也能作为探索工具，发现传统方法忽略的强设计。材料未给出具体性能数字。
brief.validation: 竞赛设计案例使用了真实行为数据（real behavioral data），并与黑盒优化、LLM 数值求解、LLM 角色扮演设计三类基准对比。未说明具体误差或对比强度。
brief.limits: 未说明。
brief.reuse: 可借鉴的包括：把设计参数嵌入 prompt、从生成文本提取数值以建模为受控 Markov 链的方法，以及单次运行同时估计零阶梯度并更新参数的 on-trajectory learning 算法。代码和数据未说明是否公开。

9e31cdca70a0d0e5.text: An essential problem in artificial intelligence is whether LLMs can simulate human cognition or merely imitate surface-level behaviors, while existing datasets suffer from either synthetic reasoning traces or population-level aggregation, failing to capture authentic individual cognitive patterns. We introduce a benchmark grounded in the longitudinal research trajectories of 217 researchers across diverse domains of artificial intelligence, where each author's scientific publications serve as an externalized representation of their cognitive processes. To distinguish whether LLMs transfer cognitive patterns or merely imitate behaviors, our benchmark deliberately employs a cross-domain, temporal-shift generalization setting. A multidimensional cognitive alignment metric is further proposed to assess individual-level cognitive consistency. Through systematic evaluation of state-of-the-art LLMs and various enhancement techniques, we provide a first-stage empirical study on the questions: (1) How well do current LLMs simulate human cognition? and (2) How far can existing techniques enhance these capabilities?
9e31cdca70a0d0e5.abstract_zh: 现有研究想回答一个问题：大模型到底能模拟人类认知，还是只模仿表层行为。已有数据集要么是合成的推理轨迹，要么只有群体层面的聚合数据，都捕捉不到真实的个体认知模式。作者为此构建了一个新基准，以217位人工智能领域研究者的纵向科研轨迹为基础，把每位学者的科学论文当作其认知过程的外化表征。为了区分模型是在迁移认知模式还是仅仅模仿行为，基准刻意采用跨领域、时间偏移的泛化设置，也就是让模型面对训练分布之外的场景。作者还提出了一个多维认知对齐指标，用来评估个体层面的认知一致性。在此基准上，他们系统评测了当前最先进的大模型和各种增强技术，给出第一阶段的经验研究，回答两个问题：现有大模型模拟人类认知的水平如何，以及现有技术能把这种能力提升到什么程度。
9e31cdca70a0d0e5.why: 它把“能否模拟人类认知”操作化成一个可测的基准，用真实学者的纵向论文轨迹做个体级对齐，这个设计对做人类行为仿真和智能体可信度评估的人都可直接复用。

brief.question: LLM 能否真正模拟人类认知，还是只模仿表层行为。现有数据集要么是合成的推理轨迹，要么是群体层面的聚合，缺少真实的个体认知模式，作者要补这个缺口。
brief.setup: 基准基于 217 位人工智能各领域研究者的长期研究轨迹，把每位作者的科研论文当作其认知过程的外化表征。采用跨领域、时间偏移的泛化设定来区分认知迁移和单纯行为模仿。未说明具体使用的模型清单和时间尺度。
brief.method: 用跨领域、时间偏移的泛化设定做评测，并提出一个多维度的认知对齐指标（multidimensional cognitive alignment metric），在个体层面衡量认知一致性。
brief.findings: 对当前最先进的 LLM 和多种增强技术做了系统评测，给出第一阶段实证结果，回答两个问题：当前 LLM 模拟人类认知的水平如何，以及现有技术能把这种能力提升多少。材料未给出具体数字。
brief.validation: 通过跨领域、时间偏移设定和个体层面的多维认知对齐指标来评测，与真实研究者的论文轨迹对照。未说明具体误差或对比强度。
brief.limits: 作者称这是第一阶段实证研究，未说明具体局限。
brief.reuse: 基于 217 位研究者论文轨迹的基准数据集和认知对齐指标，可用于评测 LLM 的个体认知模拟能力。代码和公开方式未说明。

91403e38602c1d0b.text: Persona-driven large language models (LLMs) require consistent behavioral tendencies across interactions to simulate human-like personality traits, such as persistence or reliability. However, current LLMs often lack stable internal representations that anchor their responses over extended dialogues. This work explores whether LLMs can maintain "implicit consistency", defined as persistent adherence to an unstated goal in multi-turn interactions. We designed a 20-question-style riddle game paradigm where an LLM is tasked with secretly selecting a target and responding to users' guesses with "yes/no" answers. Through evaluations, we find that LLMs struggle to preserve latent consistency: their implicit "goals" shift across turns unless explicitly provided their selected target in context. These findings highlight critical limitations in the building of persona-driven LLMs and underscore the need for mechanisms that anchor implicit goals over time, which is a key to realistic personality modeling in interactive applications such as dialogue systems.

9c2170123facefcd.text: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly utilised for social simulation and persona generation, necessitating an understanding of how they represent geopolitical identities. In this paper, we analyse personas generated for Palestinian and Israeli identities by five popular LLMs across 640 experimental conditions, varying context (war vs non-war) and assigned roles. We observe significant distributional patterns in the generated attributes: Palestinian profiles in war contexts are frequently associated with lower socioeconomic status and survival-oriented roles, whereas Israeli profiles predominantly retain middle-class status and specialised professional attributes. When prompted with explicit instructions to avoid harmful assumptions, models exhibit diverse distributional changes, e.g., marked increases in non-binary gender inferences or a convergence toward generic occupational roles (e.g., "student"), while the underlying socioeconomic distinctions often remain. Furthermore, analysis of reasoning traces reveals an interesting dynamics between model reasoning and generation: while rationales consistently mention fairness-related concepts, the final generated personas follow the aforementioned diverse distributional changes. These findings illustrate a picture of how models interpret geopolitical contexts, while suggesting that they process fairness and adjust in varied ways; there is no consistent, direct translation of fairness concepts into representative outcomes.
9c2170123facefcd.abstract_zh: 大模型越来越多地被用于社会仿真和人设生成，因此需要弄清它们如何呈现地缘政治身份。作者分析了五个流行大模型生成的巴勒斯坦和以色列人设，覆盖640个实验条件，变化维度包括语境（战争与非战争）和被分配的角色。生成属性呈现明显的分布性规律：战争语境下的巴勒斯坦人设常与较低社会经济地位和求生型角色关联，以色列人设则主要保持中产阶级地位和专业职业属性。当提示中明确要求避免有害假设时，各模型表现出不同的分布变化，例如非二元性别的推断明显增多，或职业趋向泛化（如统一变成“学生”），但底层的社会经济差异常常依然存在。对推理轨迹的分析还揭示了模型推理与生成之间的动态：推理理由中一致地提到公平相关概念，但最终生成的人设仍呈现上述各异的分布变化。这些发现展示了模型如何解读地缘政治语境，也说明它们处理公平问题的方式各不相同，公平概念并没有一致、直接地转化为有代表性的输出结果。
9c2170123facefcd.why: 对用大模型做社会仿真和合成样本的研究者，这是一份直接的偏差证据：地缘政治人设生成中存在系统性的社会经济刻板分布，且公平指令不能可靠地消除，做仿真前必须先做人设层面的偏差审计。

9d912912d6b0d364.text: Social simulation is critical for mining complex social dynamics and supporting data-driven decision making. LLM-based methods have emerged as powerful tools for this task by leveraging human-like social questionnaire responses to model group behaviors. Existing LLM-based approaches predominantly focus on group-level values at discrete time points, treating them as static snapshots rather than dynamic processes. However, group-level values are not fixed but shaped by long-term social changes. Modeling their dynamics is thus crucial for accurate social evolution prediction--a key challenge in both data mining and social science. This problem remains underexplored due to limited longitudinal data, group heterogeneity, and intricate historical event impacts. To bridge this gap, we propose a novel framework for group-level dynamic social simulation by integrating historical value trajectories into LLM-based human response modeling. We select China and the U.S. as representative contexts, conducting stratified simulations across four core sociodemographic dimensions (gender, age, education, income). Using the World Values Survey, we construct a multi-wave, group-level longitudinal dataset to capture historical value evolution, and then propose the first event-based prediction method for this task, unifying social events, current value states, and group attributes into a single framework. Evaluations across five LLM families show substantial gains: a maximum 30.88\% improvement on seen questions and 33.97\% on unseen questions over the Vanilla baseline. We further find notable cross-group heterogeneity: U.S. groups are more volatile than Chinese groups, and younger groups in both countries are more sensitive to external changes. These findings advance LLM-based social simulation and provide new insights for social scientists to understand and predict social value changes.
9d912912d6b0d364.abstract_zh:
LLM社会仿真通常靠模拟人类问卷应答来建模群体行为，但现有方法把群体价值观当作离散时间点上的静态快照，忽略了价值观由长期社会变化塑造这一事实。建模其动态过程对准确预测社会演化很关键，但受限于纵向数据稀缺、群体异质性和历史事件影响的复杂性，这一问题一直研究不足。

作者提出一个群体级动态社会仿真框架，把历史价值轨迹整合进LLM的人类应答建模。他们选中国和美国作为代表场景，沿性别、年龄、教育、收入四个社会人口维度做分层仿真，用世界价值观调查（WVS）构建多波次群体级纵向数据集来刻画历史价值演化，并提出该任务上首个基于事件的预测方法，把社会事件、当前价值状态和群体属性统一到一个框架里。

在五个LLM家族上的评测显示，相比Vanilla基线，已见问题最高提升30.88%，未见问题提升33.97%。作者还发现明显的跨群体异质性：美国群体比中国群体更易波动，两国较年轻的群体对外部变化都更敏感。这些结果推进了基于LLM的社会仿真，也为社会科学家理解和预测社会价值变化提供了新视角。
9d912912d6b0d364.why: 它把LLM社会仿真从静态快照推进到动态预测，提供了基于WVS的中美多波次群体级纵向数据集和首个事件驱动的预测方法，对做舆论与价值观演化推演的人是可直接复用的资源和基线。

brief.limits: 未说明。

91c736e21d4e3552.text: The rapid advancement of Large Language Models (LLMs) has led to a surge of financial benchmarks, evolving from static knowledge evaluation toward interactive trading simulations. However, existing frameworks for evaluating real-time trading largely overlook a critical failure mode: the severe behavioral instability of LLMs in sequential decision-making under financial uncertainty. Through extensive experiments, we show that when deployed as trading agents, LLMs exhibit extreme run-to-run variance, generate inconsistent action sequences even under deterministic decoding, and frequently produce irrational action flipping across adjacent time steps. We attribute these behaviors to the stateless autoregressive nature of LLMs, which lack persistent memory of prior actions, together with their sensitivity to continuous-to-discrete action mappings in portfolio allocation tasks. These deficiencies fundamentally undermine the reliability and reproducibility of many existing online and offline trading benchmarks. To address these limitations, we propose AlphaForgeBench, a principled evaluation framework that redefines LLMs as quantitative researchers rather than stochastic trading agents. Instead of producing discrete trading actions, AlphaForgeBench requires models to generate executable alpha factors and compose factor-based trading strategies grounded in financial knowledge. This paradigm decouples reasoning from execution mechanics, enabling deterministic and reproducible evaluation while remaining aligned with real-world quantitative research workflows. Extensive experiments across multiple state-of-the-art LLMs demonstrate that AlphaForgeBench eliminates execution-induced instability and provides a rigorous benchmark for evaluating financial reasoning, strategy formulation, and alpha discovery. Webpage at https://finbrain-lab-hkustgz.github.io/AlphaForgeBench
91c736e21d4e3552.abstract_zh:
现有金融领域的大模型评测已经从静态知识问答演进到交互式交易模拟，但作者指出这些框架忽略了一个关键失败模式：在金融不确定性下的序贯决策中，大模型行为严重不稳定。实验显示，作为交易智能体部署时，大模型表现出极大的运行间方差，即便采用确定性解码也会生成不一致的动作序列，并频繁在相邻时间步之间产生非理性的动作翻转。作者把原因归结为两点：自回归架构本身无状态，缺乏对先前动作的持久记忆；以及在组合配置任务中，模型对连续到离散的动作映射非常敏感。这些缺陷动摇了许多现有在线和离线交易基准的可靠性与可复现性。

为此作者提出 AlphaForgeBench，一个原则化的评测框架，把大模型重新定义为量化研究员，而不是随机的交易智能体。模型不再输出离散交易动作，而是生成可执行的 alpha 因子，并基于金融知识组合成因子交易策略。这个范式把推理与执行机制解耦，评测因此确定且可复现，同时贴近真实量化研究的工作流程。

多个最先进大模型上的大量实验表明，AlphaForgeBench 消除了执行导致的不稳定，为评测金融推理、策略构建和 alpha 发现提供了严格的基准。
91c736e21d4e3552.why: 它用扎实的实验揭示了大模型做交易智能体的行为不稳定这一反例，动摇了一批现有交易基准的可信度，并给出一个可复现的替代评测范式，做金融仿真和评测的人都该看看。

brief.question: 评估 LLM 作为实时交易智能体时的行为稳定性问题，并构建一个可复现的金融推理评测框架 AlphaForgeBench。
brief.setup: 未说明具体智能体数量与环境细节。评测对象为多个 state-of-the-art LLM，任务设定是让模型扮演量化研究员（quantitative researcher），生成可执行的 alpha 因子并组合成基于因子的交易策略，而非直接输出离散交易动作。
brief.method: 把 LLM 从随机交易智能体重新定义为量化研究员，要求其生成可执行 alpha 因子和因子组合策略，将推理与执行机制解耦，从而实现确定性和可复现的评测，并贴近真实量化研究工作流。
brief.findings: 实验发现 LLM 作为交易智能体时表现出极端的 run-to-run 方差，即使在确定性解码下也会生成不一致的动作序列，并在相邻时间步频繁出现非理性的动作翻转。作者将这些行为归因于 LLM 无状态自回归特性（缺乏对先前动作的持久记忆）以及对连续到离散动作映射的敏感性。AlphaForgeBench 消除了执行导致的不稳定性。
brief.validation: 作者通过大量实验对比多个 state-of-the-art LLM 在交易智能体设定下的行为表现，展示了 run-to-run 方差和动作翻转等具体现象，但未说明与真实交易数据或人类基准的定量对比。
brief.limits: 作者指出这些缺陷从根本上损害了许多现有在线和离线交易基准的可靠性与可复现性；材料未说明 AlphaForgeBench 自身的其他局限。
brief.reuse: AlphaForgeBench 评测框架，网页在 https://finbrain-lab-hkustgz.github.io/AlphaForgeBench。

9c4e7d91600a5cfc.text: How well can AI-derived synthetic research data replicate the responses of human participants? An emerging literature has begun to engage with this question, which carries deep implications for organizational research practice. This article presents a comparison between a human-respondent survey of 420 Silicon Valley coders and developers and synthetic survey data designed to simulate real survey takers generated by five leading Generative AI Large Language Models: ChatGPT Thinking 5 Pro, Claude Sonnet 4.5 Pro plus Claude CoWork 1.123, Gemini Advanced 2.5 Pro, Incredible 1.0, and DeepSeek 3.2. Our findings reveal that while AI agents produced technically plausible results that lean more towards replicability and harmonization than assumed, none were able to capture the counterintuitive insights that made the human survey valuable. Moreover, deviations grouped together for all models, leaving the real data as the outlier. Our key finding is that while leading LLMs are increasingly being used to scale, replicate and replace human survey responses in research, these advances only show an increased capacity to parrot conventional wisdom in harmony with each other rather than revealing novel findings. If synthetic respondents are used in future research, we need more replicable validation protocols and reporting standards for when and where synthetic survey data can be used responsibly, a gap that this paper fills. Our results suggest that synthetic survey responses cannot meaningfully model real human social beliefs within organizations, particularly in contexts lacking previously documented evidence. We conclude that synthetic survey-based research should be cast not as a substitute for rigorous survey methods, but as an increasingly reliable pre- or post-fieldwork instrument for identifying societal assumptions, conventional wisdoms, and other expectations about research populations.
9c4e7d91600a5cfc.abstract_zh:
这项研究问的问题是：AI 生成的合成调查数据能在多大程度上复现真人受访者的回答？作者把一份 420 名硅谷程序员和开发者的人类问卷调查，与五个主流大模型（ChatGPT Thinking 5 Pro、Claude Sonnet 4.5 Pro 加 Claude CoWork 1.123、Gemini Advanced 2.5 Pro、Incredible 1.0、DeepSeek 3.2）生成的合成受访者数据做了对比。

结果显示，各模型生成的回答在技术上看起来合理，趋同性和可复现性比预想的要好。但没有任何一个模型捕捉到那份人类调查之所以有价值的关键，即反直觉的发现。更值得注意的是，所有模型的偏差方向都聚在一起，真实数据反而成了离群值。作者据此判断，大模型合成受访者的进步只是更擅长彼此一致地复述传统常识，而不是揭示新发现。

作者认为，合成调查回答无法有意义地模拟组织内真实的人类社会信念，尤其是在缺乏既有文献记录的情境下。合成调查不应被视为严格调查方法的替代品，而应定位为田野工作之前或之后的辅助工具，用来识别关于研究人群的社会假设、传统常识和其他预期。论文还指出，如果未来研究中使用合成受访者，需要更可复现的验证协议和报告标准，说明合成调查数据在什么条件下可以负责任地使用，论文试图填补这一空白。
9c4e7d91600a5cfc.why: 它给“用大模型智能体替代真人问卷”这一流行做法提供了一个反例：五个模型彼此趋同、真人数据反而离群，说明合成样本在缺乏既有证据的情境下会丢失反直觉发现，做合成样本研究的人需要读。

95e33ecfe0ac0232.text: LLM role-playing, i.e., using LLMs to simulate specific personas, has emerged as a key capability in various applications, such as companionship, content creation and digital games. While current models effectively capture character tones and knowledge, simulating the inner thoughts behind their behaviors remains a challenge. Towards cognitive simulation in LLM role-play, previous efforts mainly suffer from two deficiencies: lacking data with high-quality reasoning traces, and lacking reliable reward signals aligned with human preferences. In this paper, we propose HER, a unified framework for cognitive-level persona simulation. HER introduces dual-layer thinking, which distinguishes characters' first-person thinking from LLMs' third-person thinking. To bridge these gaps, we curate reasoning-augmented role-playing data via reverse engineering, and construct human-aligned principles and reward models. Leveraging these resources, we train HER models based on Qwen3-32B via supervised and reinforcement learning. Extensive experiments validate the effectiveness of our approach. Notably, our models significantly outperform the Qwen3-32B baseline, achieving a 30.26 improvement on the CoSER benchmark and a 14.97% gain on the Minimax Role-Play Bench. Our datasets, principles, and models are released to facilitate future research.

9fa39fae29a6d2f5.text: Building reliable conversational AI assistants for customer-facing industries remains challenging due to noisy conversational data, fragmented knowledge, and the requirement for accurate human hand-off - particularly in domains that depend heavily on real-time information. This paper presents an end-to-end framework for constructing and evaluating a conversational AI assistant directly from historical call transcripts. Incoming transcripts are first graded using a simplified adaptation of the PIPA framework, focusing on observation alignment and appropriate response behavior, and are filtered to retain only high-quality interactions exhibiting coherent flow and effective human agent responses. Structured knowledge is then extracted from curated transcripts using large language models (LLMs) and deployed as the sole grounding source in a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipeline. Assistant behavior is governed through systematic prompt tuning, progressing from monolithic prompts to lean, modular, and governed designs that ensure consistency, safety, and controllable execution. Evaluation is conducted using a transcript-grounded user simulator, enabling quantitative measurement of call coverage, factual accuracy, and human escalation behavior. Additional red teaming assesses robustness against prompt injection, out-of-scope, and out-of-context attacks. Experiments are conducted in the Real Estate and Specialist Recruitment domains, which are intentionally challenging and currently suboptimal for automation due to their reliance on real-time data. Despite these constraints, the assistant autonomously handles approximately 30 percents of calls, achieves near-perfect factual accuracy and rejection behavior, and demonstrates strong robustness under adversarial testing.

99edd7caaf07aeba.text: Humans act via a nuanced process that depends both on rational deliberation and also on identity and contextual factors. In this work, we study how large language models (LLMs) can simulate human action in the context of social dilemma games. While prior work has focused on "steering" (weak binding) of chat models to simulate personas, we analyze here how deep binding of base models with extended backstories leads to more faithful replication of identity-based behaviors. Our study has these findings: simulation fidelity vs human studies is improved by conditioning base LMs with rich context of narrative identities and checking consistency using instruction-tuned models. We show that LLMs can also model contextual factors such as time (year that a study was performed), question framing, and participant pool effects. LLMs, therefore, allow us to explore the details that affect human studies but which are often omitted from experiment descriptions, and which hamper accurate replication.
99edd7caaf07aeba.abstract_zh: 人类的行为既依赖理性权衡，也受身份和情境因素影响。这篇论文研究大语言模型能否在社会困境博弈这类场景中模拟人类行为。以往工作多是对聊天模型做弱绑定（steering）来模拟人格，作者改用深度绑定的思路：给基础模型注入扩展的叙事化身份背景故事，再用指令微调模型检查行为一致性。结果显示，这种做法对人类研究的模拟保真度更高。作者还展示 LLM 能建模情境因素，包括实验开展的年份、问题框架方式以及被试群体差异。因此 LLM 可以用来探究那些影响人类研究结果、却常被实验描述省略、进而阻碍精确复现的细节。材料未报告具体的量化对比数字或验证数据集。
99edd7caaf07aeba.why: 它提出了一条可复用的方法路线：用叙事化长背景深度绑定基础模型加一致性校验，来提高 LLM 模拟人类身份相关行为的保真度，对做人类行为仿真和合成样本的人有直接参考价值。

98deb96c6c2a1194.text: Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in reasoning and generation, serving as the foundation for advanced persona simulation and Role-Playing Language Agents (RPLAs). However, achieving authentic alignment with human cognitive and behavioral patterns remains a critical challenge for these agents. We present HumanLLM, a framework treating psychological patterns as interacting causal forces. We construct 244 patterns from $\sim$12,000 academic papers and synthesize 11,359 scenarios where 2-5 patterns reinforce, conflict, or modulate each other, with multi-turn conversations expressing inner thoughts, actions, and dialogue. Our dual-level checklists evaluate both individual pattern fidelity and emergent multi-pattern dynamics, achieving strong human alignment ($r=0.90$) while revealing that holistic metrics conflate simulation accuracy with social desirability. HumanLLM-8B outperforms Qwen3-32B on multi-pattern dynamics despite 4$\times$ fewer parameters, demonstrating that authentic anthropomorphism requires cognitive modeling -- simulating not just what humans do, but the psychological processes generating those behaviors. Our dataset, code, and model are available at:https://github.com/YJGoodbye2024/HumanLLM
98deb96c6c2a1194.abstract_zh:
大模型在推理和生成上表现很强，是角色扮演语言智能体（RPLA）的基础，但要真实对齐人类的认知和行为模式仍然困难。作者把 HumanLLM 当成一个框架，把心理模式处理成相互作用的因果力量，而不是孤立的特征列表。

做法上，他们从约 12000 篇学术论文中构建了 244 种心理模式，并合成 11359 个场景。每个场景里 2 到 5 种模式相互强化、冲突或调节，用多轮对话表达内心想法、行动和对话。评测用双层清单，一层看单个模式的保真度，一层看多模式交互后涌现的动态。

结果上，这套评测与人类判断高度一致（r=0.90）。作者还发现，整体式的评测指标会把仿真准确性和社会期许混在一起，高估拟人程度。基于此训练的 HumanLLM-8B 在多模式动态上超过 Qwen3-32B，参数量只有对方的四分之一。这说明真实的拟人需要认知层面的建模，即模拟产生行为的心理过程，而不只是模拟行为本身。数据集、代码和模型已开源。
98deb96c6c2a1194.why: 它给出了一个可复用的拟人度基准和训练方法，并指出整体式评测会把仿真准确性和社会期许混淆，这对用大模型做人类行为仿真的研究者是直接可用的评测工具和风险提示。

brief.question: 如何让 LLM 角色扮演智能体（RPLA）真实对齐人类的认知与行为模式，而不只是表面模仿人类行为。
brief.setup: 构建 244 个心理学模式，来源约 12,000 篇学术论文；合成 11,359 个场景，每个场景中 2-5 个模式相互强化、冲突或调节，用多轮对话表达内心想法、行动和对话。
brief.method: HumanLLM 框架把心理模式当作相互作用的因果力来建模，用双层 checklist 分别评估单个模式的忠实度和多模式涌现动态。
brief.findings: 双层 checklist 与人类判断对齐达 r=0.90；整体式指标会把仿真准确度与社会期望混淆；HumanLLM-8B 在多模式动态上超过 Qwen3-32B，参数少 4 倍。
brief.validation: 与人类评估对齐，相关系数 r=0.90，并对比了整体式指标与双层 checklist 的差异；未说明具体评估人数和消融细节。
brief.limits: 作者指出整体式指标会混淆仿真准确度与社会期望；其他局限未说明。
brief.reuse: 数据集、代码和模型已开源，地址为 https://github.com/YJGoodbye2024/HumanLLM。

97de1564c7de959b.text: Synthetic personas are widely used to condition large language models (LLMs) for social simulation, yet most personas are still constructed from coarse sociodemographic attributes or summaries. We revisit persona creation by introducing SCOPE, a socially grounded framework for persona construction and evaluation, built from a 141-item, two-hour sociopsychological protocol collected from 124 U.S.-based participants. Across seven models, we find that demographic-only personas are a structural bottleneck: demographics explain only ~1.5% of variance in human response similarity. Adding sociopsychological facets improves behavioral prediction and reduces over-accentuation, and non-demographic personas based on values and identity achieve strong alignment with substantially lower bias. These trends generalize to SimBench (441 aligned questions), where SCOPE personas outperform default prompting and NVIDIA Nemotron personas, and SCOPE augmentation improves Nemotron-based personas. Our results indicate that persona quality depends on sociopsychological structure rather than demographic templates or summaries.
97de1564c7de959b.abstract_zh:
合成人格画像常被用来给大语言模型设定角色，以做社会仿真，但现有画像大多只由粗略的社会人口学属性或简短摘要拼成。作者重新审视了画像的构建方式，提出 SCOPE，一个有社会心理学根基的画像构建与评测框架。它的数据来自 124 名美国参与者完成的一份 141 项、耗时约两小时的问卷协议，覆盖价值观、身份等社会心理维度。

在七个模型上的实验显示，只用人口学属性是结构性瓶颈，人口学变量只能解释人类回答相似度中约 1.5% 的方差。加入社会心理维度后，模型对人类行为的预测变好，过度夸大特定倾向的问题也减轻了。基于价值观和身份等非人口学信息构建的画像，与真人回答的对齐度很高，同时偏差明显更低。

这些结论在 SimBench（441 道对齐问题）上得到验证。SCOPE 画像的表现优于默认提示和 NVIDIA Nemotron 生成的人格画像，而且用 SCOPE 增强后，基于 Nemotron 的画像质量也会提升。作者的结论是，画像质量取决于社会心理结构，而不是人口学模板或摘要。材料未说明代码或数据是否公开。
97de1564c7de959b.why: 它用真人数据量化了一个很多人默认成立的做法的失效，只靠年龄性别职业拼画像几乎解释不了人类回答的差异，做用户仿真或合成样本的人都该重新设计画像采集方式。

brief.question: 研究合成人设（synthetic personas）在 LLM 社会仿真中的构建方式，推演的问题是仅靠人口统计属性生成的人设能否真实模拟人类行为。
brief.setup: 基于 124 名美国参与者完成的 141 项、约两小时的社会心理学问卷协议，构建并评估 SCOPE 人设框架，测试覆盖七个模型，并在 SimBench（441 道对齐问题）上做泛化测试。
brief.method: 提出 SCOPE，一个社会性扎根的人设构建与评估框架，用社会心理学维度（价值观、身份等）替代粗粒度人口统计属性或摘要来构建人设。
brief.findings: 人口统计属性只能解释人类回答相似度约 1.5% 的方差，是结构性瓶颈。加入社会心理学维度能提升行为预测并减少过度夸大效应。基于价值观和身份的非人口统计人设在偏差明显更低的情况下实现强对齐。在 SimBench 上，SCOPE 人设优于默认提示和 NVIDIA Nemotron 人设，SCOPE 增强还能改进 Nemotron 人设的表现。
brief.validation: 与 124 名真实参与者的问卷回答对比，量化人口统计属性的解释方差（约 1.5%），并在 SimBench 的 441 道对齐问题上与默认提示和 Nemotron 人设做基准比较，跨七个模型检验趋势一致性。
brief.limits: 样本仅限 124 名美国参与者，结论向其他文化人群的推广情况材料未说明。
brief.reuse: 可直接借鉴 SCOPE 的 141 项社会心理学问卷协议和基于价值观、身份构建人设的方法，以及用 SCOPE 增强现有人设（如 Nemotron）的做法。

9a6629f35e7edeba.text: Existing user simulation approaches focus on generating user-like responses in dialogue. They often assume that the provided persona is sufficient for producing such responses, without verifying whether critical personas are supplied. This raises concerns about the validity of simulation results. To address this issue, we study the task of identifying persona dimensions (e.g., "whether the user is price-sensitive") that are relevant but missing in simulating a user's reply for a given dialogue context. We introduce PICQ-drama (constructed from TVShowGuess), a benchmark of context-aware choice questions, annotated with missing persona dimensions whose absence leads to ambiguous user choices. We further design diverse evaluation criteria for missing persona identification. Benchmarking leading LLMs on our PICQ-drama dataset demonstrates the feasibility of this task. Evaluation across diverse criteria, along with further analyses, reveals cognitive differences between LLMs and humans and highlights the distinct roles of different persona categories in shaping responses.

9b65454511cb7536.text: Standard simulations of the Iterated Prisoners Dilemma (IPD) operate in deterministic, noise-free environments, producing strategies that may be theoretically optimal but fragile when confronted with real-world uncertainty. This paper addresses two critical gaps in evolutionary game theory research: (1) the absence of realistic environmental stressors during strategy evolution, and (2) the Interpretability Gap, where evolved genetic strategies remain opaque binary sequences devoid of semantic meaning. We introduce a novel framework combining stochastic environmental perturbations (God Mode) with Large Language Model (LLM)-based behavioral profiling to transform evolved genotypes into interpretable character archetypes. Our experiments demonstrate that strategies evolved under chaotic conditions exhibit superior resilience and present distinct behavioral phenotypes, ranging from Ruthless Capitalists to Diplomatic Enforcers. These phenotypes are readily classified by LLMs but remain nearly impossible to interpret through manual genome inspection alone. This work bridges evolutionary computation with explainable AI and provides a template for automated agent characterization in multi-agent systems.
9b65454511cb7536.abstract_zh: 标准的迭代囚徒困境（IPD）仿真通常在确定性、无噪声的环境中进行，演化出的策略理论上最优，但面对真实世界的不确定性会很脆弱。论文指出演化博弈论研究里的两个缺口：一是策略演化过程缺少真实的环境压力，二是可解释性缺口，演化出的遗传策略只是不透明、没有语义的二进制序列。作者提出的框架把两部分结合起来：一是叫 God Mode 的随机环境扰动，让演化过程处于混沌条件；二是用大语言模型做行为画像，把演化出的基因型转成可解释的角色原型。实验显示，混沌条件下演化出的策略韧性更好，并呈现出从 Ruthless Capitalists 到 Diplomatic Enforcers 的多种行为表型。这些表型用 LLM 可以直接分类，但只靠人工检查基因组几乎无法解读。作者认为这项工作把演化计算和可解释 AI 连了起来，为多智能体系统里的自动化智能体角色刻画提供了模板。
9b65454511cb7536.why: 它给仿真推演里的一个老问题提供了新做法：演化算法产出的策略不透明，作者用 LLM 把基因组翻译成可读的角色原型，这个流程可以直接搬到其他多智能体仿真里做智能体刻画。

938fa5940d38797a.text: Traffic simulation is important for transportation optimization and policy making. While existing simulators such as SUMO and MATSim offer fully-featured platforms and utilities, users without too much knowledge about these platforms often face significant challenges when conducting experiments from scratch and applying them to their daily work. To solve this challenge, we propose TrafficSimAgent, an LLM-based agent framework that serves as an expert in experiment design and decision optimization for general-purpose traffic simulation tasks. The framework facilitates execution through cross-level collaboration among expert agents: high-level expert agents comprehend natural language instructions with high flexibility, plan the overall experiment workflow, and invoke corresponding MCP-compatible tools on demand; meanwhile, low-level expert agents select optimal action plans for fundamental elements based on real-time traffic conditions. Extensive experiments across multiple scenarios show that TrafficSimAgent effectively executes simulations under various conditions and consistently produces reasonable outcomes even when user instructions are ambiguous. Besides, the carefully designed expert-level autonomous decision-driven optimization in TrafficSimAgent yields superior performance when compared with other systems and SOTA LLM based methods.
938fa5940d38797a.abstract_zh: 交通仿真对交通优化和政策制定很重要，但 SUMO、MATSim 这类成熟仿真平台功能齐全，不熟悉它们的用户从零开始做实验、把仿真用到日常工作里仍然很困难。针对这个问题，作者提出 TrafficSimAgent，一个基于大语言模型的智能体框架，充当通用交通仿真任务的实验设计与决策优化专家。框架靠跨层协作的专家智能体执行任务：高层专家智能体灵活理解自然语言指令，规划整体实验流程，按需调用相应的 MCP 兼容工具；低层专家智能体基于实时交通状况为基本元素选择最优动作方案。作者在多个场景下做了大量实验，结果显示 TrafficSimAgent 能在各种条件下有效执行仿真，即使用户指令模糊也能稳定产出合理结果。此外，框架中精心设计的专家级自主决策驱动优化，在与其他系统和 SOTA LLM 方法比较时取得了更好的性能。局限方面，材料未提供具体场景数量、指标数值或与真实交通数据的对比情况。
938fa5940d38797a.why: 它展示了把 MCP 工具调用和分层专家智能体接到成熟交通仿真器上的一条可行路径，对想用自然语言驱动 SUMO/MATSim 做推演的从业者是可以直接参考的框架设计。

brief.question: 解决不熟悉 SUMO、MATSim 等仿真平台的用户难以从零搭建交通仿真实验的问题，让用户用自然语言指令完成交通仿真与决策优化。
brief.setup: LLM 驱动的分层智能体框架，包含高层专家智能体和底层专家智能体，面向通用交通仿真任务，具体智能体数量、环境规模和时间尺度未说明。
brief.method: 高层专家智能体理解自然语言指令、规划整体实验流程并按需调用 MCP 兼容工具；底层专家智能体基于实时交通状况为基本元素选择最优行动方案，两层通过跨层协作执行仿真。
brief.findings: 在多个场景的实验中，TrafficSimAgent 能在各种条件下有效执行仿真，用户指令模糊时也能产出合理结果；其专家级自主决策驱动优化在与其他系统和 SOTA LLM 方法的对比中表现更优，具体数字未说明。
brief.validation: 与其它系统和 SOTA LLM 方法做了对比实验，但对比基准、指标和误差数值未说明。
brief.limits: 未说明。
brief.reuse: MCP 兼容工具调用机制和分层专家智能体协作的框架设计可借鉴，代码和数据是否开源未说明。

9acdb3d2c8f0a103.text: Evaluating large language models (LLMs) has recently emerged as a critical issue for safe and trustworthy application of LLMs in the medical domain. Although a variety of static medical question-answering (QA) benchmarks have been proposed, many aspects remain underexplored, such as the effectiveness of LLMs in generating responses in dynamic, interactive clinical multi-turn conversation situations and the identification of multi-faceted evaluation strategies beyond simple accuracy. However, formally evaluating a dynamic, interactive clinical situation is hindered by its vast combinatorial space of possible patient states and interaction trajectories, making it difficult to standardize and quantitatively measure such scenarios. Here, we introduce AutoMedic, a multi-agent simulation framework that enables automated evaluation of LLMs as clinical conversational agents. AutoMedic transforms off-the-shelf static QA datasets into virtual patient profiles, enabling realistic and clinically grounded multi-turn clinical dialogues between LLM agents. The performance of various clinical conversational agents is then assessed based on our CARE metric, which provides a multi-faceted evaluation standard of clinical conversational accuracy, efficiency/strategy, empathy, and robustness. Our findings, validated by human experts, demonstrate the validity of AutoMedic as an automated evaluation framework for clinical conversational agents, offering practical guidelines for the effective development of LLMs in conversational medical applications.
9acdb3d2c8f0a103.abstract_zh: 在医疗领域安全使用大模型，评测是关键问题。现有评测多依赖静态医疗问答基准，但大模型在动态、交互式多轮临床对话中的表现，以及准确率之外的多维评测方法，都还缺少系统研究。动态临床场景的难点在于病人状态和交互轨迹的组合空间太大，难以标准化和定量测量。作者为此提出 AutoMedic，一个多智能体仿真框架，用于自动评测作为临床对话智能体的大模型。它把现成的静态问答数据集转换成虚拟病人档案，让大模型智能体之间生成有临床依据的多轮对话。对话质量用作者提出的 CARE 指标衡量，覆盖四个维度：临床对话准确性、效率与策略、共情和鲁棒性。人类专家验证了 AutoMedic 作为自动化评测框架的有效性，结果也为医疗对话应用中大模型的开发提供了实践参考。
9acdb3d2c8f0a103.why: 它示范了如何把静态 QA 数据集改造成多智能体交互仿真来评测 LLM，这种数据转换思路和 CARE 多维指标对做对话式仿真评测的研究者可直接复用。

957d049d5c36354e.text: Economic decision-making depends not only on structured signals such as prices and taxes, but also on unstructured language, including peer dialogue and media narratives. While multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) has shown promise in optimizing economic decisions, it struggles with the semantic ambiguity and contextual richness of language. We propose LAMP (Language-Augmented Multi-Agent Policy), a framework that integrates language into economic decision-making and narrows the gap to real-world settings. LAMP follows a Think-Speak-Decide pipeline: (1) Think interprets numerical observations to extract short-term shocks and long-term trends, caching high-value reasoning trajectories; (2) Speak crafts and exchanges strategic messages based on reasoning, updating beliefs by parsing peer communications; and (3) Decide fuses numerical data, reasoning, and reflections into a MARL policy to optimize language-augmented decision-making. Experiments in economic simulation show that LAMP outperforms both MARL and LLM-only baselines in cumulative return (+63.5%, +34.0%), robustness (+18.8%, +59.4%), and interpretability. These results demonstrate the potential of language-augmented policies to deliver more effective and robust economic strategies.
957d049d5c36354e.abstract_zh:
经济决策不只依赖价格、税收这类结构化信号，还依赖同伴对话和媒体叙事等非结构化语言。多智能体强化学习（MARL）在优化经济决策上已有成效，但难以处理语言的语义模糊和上下文丰富性。作者据此提出 LAMP（Language-Augmented Multi-Agent Policy），把语言整合进经济决策，缩小仿真与真实场景的差距。

LAMP 按 Think-Speak-Decide 三步运行。Think 步骤解读数值观察，提取短期冲击和长期趋势，并缓存高价值的推理轨迹；Speak 步骤基于推理生成并交换策略性消息，通过解析同伴通信更新信念；Decide 步骤把数值数据、推理和反思融合进 MARL 策略，优化语言增强下的决策。

经济仿真实验显示，LAMP 在累计收益上比 MARL 基线高 63.5%，比纯 LLM 基线高 34.0%；鲁棒性分别提升 18.8% 和 59.4%，可解释性也更好。结果表明语言增强策略能带来更有效、更稳健的经济策略。
957d049d5c36354e.why: 它给出了一条把 LLM 语言推理和 MARL 数值优化拼在一起的可行管线，对做经济市场仿真的研究者来说，收益和鲁棒性的提升幅度以及 Think-Speak-Decide 的设计都值得参考。

901276a189efe2d9.text: The emergence of Large Language Models (LLMs) demonstrates their potential to encapsulate the logic and patterns inherent in human behavior simulation by leveraging extensive web data pre-training. However, the boundaries of LLM capabilities in social simulation remain unclear. To further explore the social attributes of LLMs, we introduce the CiteAgent framework, designed to generate citation networks based on human-behavior simulation with LLM-based agents. CiteAgent successfully captures predominant phenomena in real-world citation networks, including power-law distribution, citational distortion, and shrinking diameter. Building on this realistic simulation, we establish two LLM-based research paradigms in social science: LLM-SE (LLM-based Survey Experiment) and LLM-LE (LLM-based Laboratory Experiment). These paradigms facilitate rigorous analyses of citation network phenomena, allowing us to validate and challenge existing theories. Additionally, we extend the research scope of traditional science of science studies through idealized social experiments, with the simulation experiment results providing valuable insights for real-world academic environments. Our work demonstrates the potential of LLMs for advancing science of science research in social science.
901276a189efe2d9.abstract_zh: 大模型在海量网络数据上预训练，有望捕捉人类行为的逻辑和模式，但它在社会仿真中的能力边界还不清楚。作者为此提出 CiteAgent 框架，用基于大模型的智能体模拟人类行为，生成引文网络。仿真结果成功捕捉了真实引文网络中的主要现象，包括幂律分布、引用失真和直径收缩。在这个较真实的仿真基础上，作者建立了两种基于大模型的社会科学研究范式：LLM-SE（基于大模型的调查实验）和 LLM-LE（基于大模型的实验室实验）。这两种范式支持对引文网络现象做严格分析，可以验证也可以挑战现有理论。作者还通过理想化社会实验扩展了传统科学学的研究范围，仿真实验的结果为现实学术环境提供了有参考价值的洞察。整体工作展示了大模型推动社会科学中科学学研究的潜力。
901276a189efe2d9.why: 它把大模型智能体仿真从复现现象推进到可检验理论的研究范式（LLM-SE 和 LLM-LE），对想用仿真做社会实验、验证或挑战既有理论的研究者是可直接借鉴的方法设计。

9d55a9f268496eee.text: Despite rapid progress, current AI agents are primarily optimized for isolated task completion. We argue for a paradigm shift toward training agents as collaborators that communicate and adapt to people. To facilitate this shift in real-world complex applications, we first formalize three dimensions of collaborative AI agents: Productivity, Proactivity, and Personalization (PPP). We introduce UserVille, an interactive environment with configurable LLM-based user simulators and user-centric feedback to evaluate these dimensions, and propose a multi-objective reinforcement learning framework that optimizes them using rewards from task outcomes, question effort, and preference adherence. On two real-world agentic tasks (SWE-Bench and BrowseComp-Plus), PPP-trained agents outperform strong LLM baselines (including GPT-5) by an average of 16.7 points, ask more targeted questions, and generalize to unseen preferences and tasks. A follow-up user study further highlights the importance of user-centric feedback for training collaborative agents that are both more effective and easier to supervise.
9d55a9f268496eee.abstract_zh: 现有 AI 智能体主要针对孤立任务完成来优化，作者主张转向把智能体训练成能与用户沟通并适应用户的协作者。为此他们先形式化了协作型智能体的三个维度：产出（Productivity）、主动性（Proactivity）和个性化（Personalization），合称 PPP。接着他们构建了 UserVille，一个交互式环境，内含可配置的基于 LLM 的用户模拟器和以用户为中心的反馈信号，用来评测这三个维度。训练方法上，他们提出一个多目标强化学习框架，用任务结果、提问成本和偏好遵循三类奖励来联合优化。在两个真实世界的智能体任务 SWE-Bench 和 BrowseComp-Plus 上，PPP 训练出的智能体平均比包括 GPT-5 在内的强 LLM 基线高出 16.7 分，提问更有针对性，并且能泛化到没见过的偏好和任务。后续的用户研究进一步表明，以用户为中心的反馈对训练既更有效也更容易监督的协作型智能体很重要。
9d55a9f268496eee.why: 它给出了一个可复用的用户模拟环境 UserVille 和一套把主动性、个性化纳入强化学习奖励的具体做法，对需要在仿真环境里训练和评测人机协作智能体的研究者有直接参考价值。

9610ee649bf9c047.text: As emerging mobility modes continue to expand, many cities face declining bus ridership, increasing fiscal pressure to sustain underutilized routes, and growing inefficiencies in resource allocation. This study employs an agent-based modelling (ABM) approach calibrated through a large language model (LLM) using few-shot learning to examine how progressive bus route cutbacks affect passenger dissatisfaction across demographic groups and overall network resilience. Using IC-card data from Beijing's Huairou District, the LLM-calibrated ABM estimated passenger sensitivity parameters related to travel time, waiting, transfers, and crowding. Results show that the structural configuration of the bus network exerts a stronger influence on system stability than capacity or operational factors. The elimination of high-connectivity routes led to an exponential rise in total dissatisfaction, particularly among passengers with disabilities and older adults. The evolution of dissatisfaction exhibited three distinct phases - stable, transitional, and critical. Through the analysis of each stage, this study found that the continuous bus route reduction scenario exhibits three-stage thresholds. Once these thresholds are crossed, even a small reduction in routes may lead to a significant loss of passenger flow. Research highlights the nonlinear response of user sentiment to service reductions and underscore the importance of maintaining structural critical routes and providing stable services to vulnerable groups for equitable and resilient transport planning.
9610ee649bf9c047.abstract_zh:
许多城市面临公交客流下滑、低效线路财政压力加大的问题，需要削减线路，但削减对乘客的影响难以评估。作者采用智能体仿真（ABM），并用大语言模型通过少样本学习来校准模型，估计乘客对出行时间、候车、换乘和拥挤的敏感度参数。数据来自北京怀柔区的公交 IC 卡记录。

仿真模拟了公交线网渐进式削减的过程。结果显示，线网的结构配置对系统稳定性的影响强于运力或运营因素。取消高连通性线路后，总不满呈指数级上升，残疾人和老年乘客受影响尤其明显。不满的演化呈现稳定、过渡、临界三个阶段，连续削减线路存在三阶段阈值，一旦越过阈值，即使小幅削减线路也可能导致客流显著流失。

研究指出了用户情绪对服务削减的非线性响应，强调交通规划应保留结构性关键线路，并为弱势群体提供稳定服务，以实现公平和有韧性的公交系统。
9610ee649bf9c047.why: 它示范了用 LLM 少样本学习校准 ABM 参数的做法，且基于真实 IC 卡数据，对做公交线网调整推演和公平性评估的从业者有直接参考价值。

resources.name: 北京怀柔区公交 IC 卡数据（论文使用）

brief.question: 推演公交线网逐步削减的场景，考察乘客不满情绪如何随削减演变，以及线网结构对系统稳定性的影响。
brief.setup: 基于北京怀柔区 IC 卡数据构建 agent-based model（ABM），用大语言模型通过 few-shot learning 校准模型参数。智能体为公交乘客，按人口群体区分（含残障乘客和老年人）。
brief.method: LLM 校准的 ABM，估计乘客对出行时间、候车、换乘、拥挤度的敏感性参数，模拟渐进式削减线路的过程。
brief.findings: 线网结构配置对系统稳定性的影响强于运力或运营因素。删除高连通性线路导致总不满情绪指数级上升，残障乘客和老年人受影响最大。不满演变分三个阶段：稳定期、过渡期、临界期。跨过三阶段阈值后，即使小幅削减线路也会造成客流显著流失。
brief.validation: 使用北京怀柔区真实 IC 卡数据校准模型，未说明与真实削减事件的对比结果或误差量化。
brief.limits: 未说明。
brief.reuse: LLM few-shot 校准 ABM 参数的方法，以及基于 IC 卡数据估计乘客敏感性参数的流程，未说明是否开源代码或数据。

98dab2d53d2b23fb.text: Large Language Models are being used in conversational agents that simulate human conversations and generate social studies data. While concerns about the models' biases have been raised and discussed in the literature, much about the data generated is still unknown. In this study we explore the statistical representation of social values across four countries (UK, Argentina, USA and China) for six LLMs, with equal representation for open and closed weights. By comparing machine-generated outputs with actual human survey data, we assess whether algorithmic biases in LLMs outweigh the biases inherent in real- world sampling, including demographic and response biases. Our findings suggest that, despite the logistical and financial constraints of human surveys, even a small, skewed sample of real respondents may provide more reliable insights than synthetic data produced by LLMs. These results highlight the limitations of using AI-generated text for social research and emphasize the continued importance of empirical human data collection.
98dab2d53d2b23fb.abstract_zh: LLM 正被用于对话式智能体，模拟人类对话并生成社会研究数据。模型偏见问题已有不少讨论，但生成数据本身的性质仍不清楚。作者在四个国家（英国、阿根廷、美国、中国）比较了六个 LLM 对社会价值观的统计代表性，开源与闭源权重模型各占一半。做法是把机器生成的输出与真实人类调查数据对比，评估 LLM 的算法偏见是否超过真实抽样中固有的偏差，包括人口统计偏差和应答偏差。结果显示，尽管人类调查有后勤和成本上的限制，一个规模小、有偏的真实受访者样本仍可能比 LLM 产生的合成数据提供更可靠的洞见。这些结果指出了用 AI 生成文本做社会研究的局限，也强调了继续收集实证人类数据的重要性。
98dab2d53d2b23fb.why: 它直接回应了“LLM 能否替代真人问卷”这个热门问题，用跨国真实调查数据给出否定证据，是合成样本方向的重要反例，做仿真推演的人在选择数据源时应参考。

brief.question: LLM 生成的合成社会数据能否替代真实人类调查数据，即 LLM 的算法偏差是否超过真实抽样中的人口与应答偏差。
brief.setup: 比较四个国家（UK、Argentina、USA、China）社会价值观的统计表征，使用六个 LLM，开源与闭源权重各占一半，与真实人类调查数据对比。
brief.method: 将机器生成的输出与实际人类调查数据对比，评估 LLM 的算法偏差相对于真实抽样偏差（人口偏差与应答偏差）的大小。
brief.findings: 结论是即使真实样本规模小且有偏，其可靠性仍可能高于 LLM 产生的合成数据；材料未给出具体数字。
brief.validation: 与四个国家的真实人类调查数据直接对比，但材料未说明具体误差指标或对比强度。
brief.limits: 材料指出用 AI 生成文本做社会研究存在局限，强调继续收集实证人类数据的重要性；未说明其他具体局限。
brief.reuse: 未说明。

9b9ac735c0520de6.text: Deploying capable and user-aligned LLM-based systems necessitates reliable evaluation. While LLMs excel in verifiable tasks like coding and mathematics, where gold-standard solutions are available, adoption remains challenging for subjective tasks that lack a single correct answer. E-commerce Query Rewriting (QR) is one such problem where determining whether a rewritten query properly captures the user intent is extremely difficult to figure out algorithmically. In this work, we introduce OptAgent, a novel framework that combines multi-agent simulations with genetic algorithms to verify and optimize queries for QR. Instead of relying on a static reward model or a single LLM judge, our approach uses multiple LLM-based agents, each acting as a simulated shopping customer, as a dynamic reward signal. The average of these agent-derived scores serves as an effective fitness function for an evolutionary algorithm that iteratively refines the user's initial query. We evaluate OptAgent on a dataset of 1000 real-world e-commerce queries in five different categories, and we observe an average improvement of 21.98% over the original user query and 3.36% over a Best-of-N LLM rewriting baseline.

972da3992f246e57.text: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to simulate human behavior in business, economics, and the social sciences, offering a low-cost complement to laboratory experiments, field studies, and surveys. This paper evaluates how well LLMs replicate human behavior in operations management. Using nine published behavioral-operations experiments, we assess LLM performance along two dimensions: whether LLM-generated data reproduce the original hypothesis-test outcomes, and whether their full response distributions align with human data, measured by Wasserstein distance. We find that LLMs often replicate hypothesis-level effects, suggesting that they can capture salient decision biases and behavioral regularities. However, their response distributions frequently diverge from human data, even for strong proprietary models, with dispersion mismatch playing an important role. We also examine two lightweight mitigation strategies: chain-of-thought prompting and hyperparameter tuning. Both can reduce distributional misalignment, and appropriate tuning can sometimes allow smaller or open-source models to match or outperform larger proprietary systems.
972da3992f246e57.abstract_zh: LLM 越来越多地被用来在商业、经济和社会科学中模拟人类行为，作为实验室实验、田野研究和问卷调查的低成本补充。这篇论文关注运营管理领域，问的是 LLM 到底模拟得像不像真人。作者选了九个已发表的行为运营实验作为基准，从两个维度评估 LLM 的表现。第一个维度看 LLM 生成的数据能否复现原研究的假设检验结果，第二个维度看 LLM 回答的完整分布与真人数据的对齐程度，用 Wasserstein 距离衡量。结果分两层。在效应层面，LLM 往往能复现原假设检验的结果，说明它们能捕捉到显著的决策偏差和行为规律。但在分布层面，LLM 的回答分布经常与真人数据偏离，即便是强大的专有模型也不例外，其中离散度的失配起了重要作用。作者还测试了两种轻量级缓解手段，即思维链提示和超参数调优。两者都能降低分布层面的偏差，而且合适的调优有时能让较小或开源的模型追平甚至超过更大的专有系统。意义在于提醒使用者，LLM 仿真在效应方向上可信，但拿它生成完整分布或替代样本时要小心；局限是材料未说明九个实验的具体领域覆盖和模型清单。
972da3992f246e57.why: 它给出了一个少见的系统性反例，LLM 仿真复现效应容易、复现分布难，并提供了可操作的缓解手段，对任何想用 LLM 智能体替代真人被试做推演或合成样本的人都该先看这份检验。

brief.question: 评估 LLM 能否替代真人被试，模拟运营管理（operations management）中的人类行为，即 LLM 生成的行为数据是否可信。
brief.setup: 使用九个已发表的行为运营（behavioral-operations）实验作为基准，让 LLM 生成被试响应数据，与原实验的人类数据对比。材料未说明具体模型清单、智能体数量和时间尺度。
brief.method: 沿两个维度评估：一是 LLM 数据能否复现原实验的假设检验结果（hypothesis-test outcomes），二是用 Wasserstein 距离衡量 LLM 响应分布与人类分布的对齐程度。另测试了两种轻量缓解策略：chain-of-thought prompting 和超参数调优。
brief.findings: LLM 常能复现假设层面的效应，说明它能捕捉显著的决策偏差和行为规律。但响应分布经常与人类数据偏离，强专有模型也不例外，离散度不匹配（dispersion mismatch）是重要原因。两种缓解策略都能降低分布错位，合适的调优有时能让较小或开源模型追平甚至超过更大的专有系统。
brief.validation: 与九个已发表实验的真实人类数据对比，检验方式包括假设检验结果复现和 Wasserstein 距离。材料未给出具体误差数字，验证强度为中等：覆盖九个实验，但分布对齐普遍不达标。
brief.limits: 分布层面偏离人类数据，即使强专有模型也如此；离散度不匹配问题突出。材料未说明其他局限。
brief.reuse: 可直接借鉴的评估框架：用已发表实验做基准，按假设复现和 Wasserstein 距离双维度打分；两种缓解手段（chain-of-thought prompting、超参数调优）可直接套用。材料未说明是否开源代码或数据。

9abe06979694aaa2.text: Social scientists are now using large language models to create "silicon samples": synthetic datasets intended to stand in for human respondents. However, producing these samples requires many analytic choices, including model selection, sampling parameters, prompt format, and the amount of demographic or contextual information provided. Across two studies, I examine whether these choices materially affect correspondence between silicon samples and human data. In Study 1, I generated 252 silicon-sample configurations for a controlled case study using two social-psychological scales, evaluating whether configurations recovered participant rankings, response distributions, and between-scale correlations. Configurations varied substantially across all three criteria, and configurations that performed well on one dimension often performed poorly on another. In Study 2, I extended this analysis to a published silicon-sample use case by re-examining Argyle et al.'s (2023) Study 3 using 66 alternative configurations. Correlations between human and silicon association structures differed substantially across configurations, from r = .23 to r = .84. Taken together, the results from these studies demonstrate that different defensible configuration choices can materially alter conclusions about the fidelity of silicon samples. I call for greater attention to the threat of analytic flexibility in using silicon samples and outline strategies that researchers may adopt to reduce this threat.
9abe06979694aaa2.abstract_zh: 社会科学家开始用大语言模型生成“硅样本”，即替代真人受访者的合成数据集。但生成过程涉及大量分析选择：选哪个模型、采样参数、提示格式、提供多少人口统计或背景信息。作者用两个研究检验这些选择是否实质影响硅样本与人类数据的对应程度。研究一是受控案例，用两个社会心理学量表生成 252 种硅样本配置，评估各配置能否还原被试排序、回答分布和量表间相关。配置在三个标准上差异都很大，且在某一维度表现好的配置常在另一维度表现差。研究二把分析扩展到已发表的硅样本案例，对 Argyle 等人 2023 年的 Study 3 用 66 种替代配置重新检验，人与硅样本关联结构的相关系数在不同配置间从 r = .23 到 r = .84 不等。两项研究说明，不同的、各自都说得通的分析选择可以实质改变关于硅样本保真度的结论。作者呼吁关注硅样本使用中的分析灵活性威胁，并给出研究者可采取的降低该威胁的策略。
9abe06979694aaa2.why: 它用系统实验证明 LLM 仿真人类数据的结论高度依赖配置选择，对任何想用硅样本替代真人样本做仿真或推演的人都是必须正视的方法学风险。

brief.question: 社会科学家用大语言模型生成“silicon samples”（硅基样本）来替代人类受访者，作者推演的问题是：生成这些样本所需的多种分析选择（模型选择、采样参数、提示格式、提供的人口或情境信息量）是否会实质影响硅基样本与人类数据的一致性。
brief.setup: 研究1针对一个受控案例生成252种硅基样本配置，使用两个社会心理学量表；研究2重新分析 Argyle 等人（2023）的 Study 3，使用66种替代配置。材料未说明所用具体模型、智能体数量和时间尺度。
brief.method: 比较不同配置在三项标准上的表现：是否还原参与者排名、回答分布、量表间相关（研究1）；人类与硅基关联结构之间的相关（研究2）。
brief.findings: 研究1中252种配置在三项标准上差异很大，且在某一维度表现好的配置常在其他维度表现差。研究2中人类与硅基关联结构的相关系数随配置从 r = .23 变到 r = .84。结论是不同合理可辩护的配置选择会实质改变关于硅基样本保真度的结论。
brief.validation: 研究1与受控案例的人类参与者数据对比（排名、分布、相关）；研究2与已发表的 Argyle 等人（2023）Study 3 人类数据对比。验证强度体现在配置间结果差异极大（r 从 .23 到 .84），说明结论对配置高度敏感。
brief.limits: 作者指出分析灵活性本身是威胁：不同合理配置可得出不同结论，硅基样本的保真度判断不稳定。材料未说明其他局限。
brief.reuse: 作者提出了研究者可采用以降低这一威胁的策略（材料未列具体内容），研究本身提供了可复用的评估框架：用多项标准（排名、分布、相关）和多配置对比来检验硅基样本的稳健性。

965fbf68a01424fe.text: Students' mental well-being is vital for academic success, with activities such as studying, socializing, and sleeping playing a role. Current mobile sensing data highlight this intricate link using statistical and machine learning analyses. We propose a novel LLM agent-based simulation framework to model student activities and mental health using the StudentLife Dataset. Each LLM agent was initialized with personality questionnaires and guided by smartphone sensing data throughout the simulated semester. These agents predict individual behaviors, provide self-reported mental health data via ecological momentary assessments (EMAs), and complete follow-up personality questionnaires. To ensure accuracy, we investigated various prompting techniques, memory systems, and activity-based mental state management strategies that dynamically update an agent's mental state based on their daily activities. This simulation goes beyond simply replicating existing data. This allows us to explore new scenarios that are not present in the original dataset, such as peer influence through agent-to-agent interactions and the impact of social media. Furthermore, we can conduct intervention studies by manipulating activity patterns via sensing signals and personality traits using questionnaire responses. This provides valuable insights into the behavioral changes that could enhance student well-being. The framework also facilitates hypothetical interviews with LLM agents, offering deeper insights into their mental health. This study showcases the power of LLM-driven behavioral modeling with sensing data, opening new avenues for understanding and supporting student mental health.
965fbf68a01424fe.abstract_zh: 学生的心理健康与学业表现关系密切，学习、社交、睡眠等日常活动都在其中起作用。现有的手机传感数据研究主要靠统计和机器学习方法分析这种联系。作者提出一个新的 LLM 智能体仿真框架，用 StudentLife 数据集来建模学生的活动和心理健康。每个智能体先用性格问卷初始化，再在整个模拟学期中由智能手机传感数据引导。这些智能体预测个体行为，通过生态瞬时评估（EMA）提供自我报告的心理健康数据，并完成后续性格问卷。为了提高准确性，作者测试了多种提示技术、记忆系统，以及基于活动的心理状态管理策略，即根据智能体每天的动态更新其心理状态。这个仿真不只是复现已有数据。它允许探索原数据集中不存在的场景，比如智能体之间互动带来的同伴影响，以及社交媒体的影响。作者还能通过传感信号操纵活动模式、通过问卷响应操纵性格特征来做干预研究，从而了解哪些行为改变可能改善学生的心理健康。框架还支持对 LLM 智能体做假设性访谈，深入了解它们的心理健康状况。材料未报告仿真结果与真实数据的具体对比数字。
965fbf68a01424fe.why: 它示范了如何把真实手机传感数据接入 LLM 智能体做个体级行为与心理健康建模，并支持原数据里没有的干预实验和同伴影响场景，对做人类行为仿真的研究者是可复用的思路。

brief.question: 用 LLM 智能体仿真学生的日常活动与心理健康状况，探索原始数据中不存在的场景，如同伴影响、社交媒体影响和干预实验。
brief.setup: 基于 StudentLife Dataset，每个 LLM 智能体用性格问卷初始化，并在模拟学期中由智能手机感知数据引导。智能体数量未说明，使用的具体模型未说明。
brief.method: 智能体预测个体行为、通过 ecological momentary assessments (EMAs) 提供自报心理健康数据、完成后续性格问卷。作者测试了多种 prompting 技术、记忆系统，以及基于活动的心理状态管理策略，根据每日活动动态更新智能体的心理状态。
brief.findings: 框架可以复现学生行为与心理健康数据，并支持新场景探索：agent-to-agent 交互的同伴影响、社交媒体影响、通过操纵活动模式和性格特质做干预研究，还可以对 LLM 智能体做假设性访谈以了解其心理健康。具体数字未说明。
brief.validation: 未说明。摘要提到为准确性测试了多种 prompting、记忆和状态管理策略，但没有给出与真实数据的对比结果或误差数字。
brief.limits: 未说明。
brief.reuse: 可借鉴的思路：用性格问卷初始化 LLM 智能体、用感知数据引导仿真、用 EMA 采集自报数据、用基于活动的动态心理状态更新机制。代码和数据可用性未说明。

9755cd21fabb05ab.text: As Large Language Models (LLMs) continue to exhibit increasingly human-like capabilities, aligning them with human values has become critically important. Contemporary advanced techniques, such as prompt learning and reinforcement learning, are being deployed to better align LLMs with human values. However, while these approaches address broad ethical considerations and helpfulness, they rarely focus on simulating individualized human value systems. To address this gap, we present ValueSim, a framework that simulates individual values through the generation of personal backstories reflecting past experiences and demographic information. ValueSim converts structured individual data into narrative backstories and employs a multi-module architecture inspired by the Cognitive-Affective Personality System to simulate individual values based on these narratives. Testing ValueSim on a self-constructed benchmark derived from the World Values Survey demonstrates an improvement in top-1 accuracy by over 10% compared to retrieval-augmented generation methods. Further analysis reveals that performance enhances as additional user interaction history becomes available, indicating the model's ability to refine its persona simulation capabilities over time.
9755cd21fabb05ab.abstract_zh: 现有的大模型价值对齐技术，比如提示学习和强化学习，主要处理宽泛的伦理与有用性问题，很少针对单个个体的价值系统做模拟。作者提出 ValueSim 框架来补这个缺口。做法分两步：先把结构化的个体数据转换成反映过去经历和人口信息的叙事背景故事，再用一个受认知情感人格系统（CAPS）启发的多模块架构，基于这些叙事来模拟个体价值观。作者用世界价值观调查（WVS）数据自建了一个基准来测试。结果显示，ValueSim 的 top-1 准确率比检索增强生成方法高出 10% 以上。进一步分析发现，随着可用的用户交互历史增多，性能还会提升，说明模型能随时间逐步修正对人格的模拟。局限方面，材料只报告了基准上的对比结果，没有与真实个体行为的长期追踪验证。
9755cd21fabb05ab.why: 它给出了一条可复用的思路：用叙事化背景故事加认知架构来模拟个体价值观，比检索增强方法在 WVS 基准上高出 10 个百分点，对做人类行为仿真和合成受访者的人有直接参考价值。

97ff3632265e48b2.text: Training and evaluating autonomous driving algorithms requires a diverse range of scenarios. However, most available datasets predominantly consist of normal driving behaviors demonstrated by human drivers, resulting in a limited number of safety-critical cases. This imbalance, often referred to as a long-tail distribution, restricts the ability of driving algorithms to learn from crucial scenarios involving risk or failure, scenarios that are essential for humans to develop driving skills efficiently. To generate such scenarios, we utilize Multi-modal Large Language Models to convert crash reports of accidents into a structured scenario format, which can be directly executed within simulations. Specifically, we introduce CrashAgent, a multi-agent framework designed to interpret multi-modal real-world traffic crash reports for the generation of both road layouts and the behaviors of the ego vehicle and surrounding traffic participants. We comprehensively evaluate the generated crash scenarios from multiple perspectives, including the accuracy of layout reconstruction, collision rate, and diversity. The resulting high-quality and large-scale crash dataset will be publicly available to support the development of safe driving algorithms in handling safety-critical situations.

93830379823a1268.text: Past work has demonstrated that autonomous vehicles can drive more safely if they communicate with each other. However, this communication is usually not human-understandable. Using natural language as a vehicle-to-vehicle (V2V) communication protocol offers the potential for autonomous vehicles to drive cooperatively not only with each other but also with human drivers. To explore the potential use of natural language for V2V communication, we develop LLM-based driving agents and study their interactions in a new simulation environment, TalkingVehiclesGym, which features traffic scenarios where communication can potentially help avoid imminent collisions and/or support efficient traffic flow. While LLM agents relying solely on chain-of-thought reasoning struggle to coordinate effectively, we introduce CoopReflect, a multi-agent learning framework that equips agents with knowledge for both natural language message generation and high-level decision-making through trial and error and multi-agent debriefing. Experiments show that CoopReflect produces more meaningful and human-understandable messages than existing baselines, enabling stronger cooperation. Finally, we distill scenario-specific knowledge into a unified language model policy, achieving cross-scenario generalization and substantially reducing decision-making latency. Our code and demo videos are available at https://talking-vehicles.github.io/.

9e231c2d620e6712.text: Designing and evaluating personalized and proactive assistant agents remains challenging due to the time, cost, and ethical concerns associated with human-in-the-loop experimentation. Existing Human-Computer Interaction (HCI) methods often require extensive physical setup and human participation, which introduces privacy concerns and limits scalability. Simulated environments offer a partial solution but are typically constrained by rule-based scenarios and still depend heavily on human input to guide interactions and interpret results. Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have introduced the possibility of generative agents that can simulate realistic human behavior, reasoning, and social dynamics. However, their effectiveness in modeling human-assistant interactions remains largely unexplored. To address this gap, we present a generative agent-based simulation platform designed to simulate human-assistant interactions. We identify ten prior studies on assistant agents that span different aspects of interaction design and replicate these studies using our simulation platform. Our results show that fully simulated experiments using generative agents can approximate key aspects of human-assistant interactions. Based on these simulations, we are able to replicate the core conclusions of the original studies. Our work provides a scalable and cost-effective approach for studying assistant agent design without requiring live human subjects. Additional resources and project materials are available at https://dash-gidea.github.io/
9e231c2d620e6712.abstract_zh: 设计和评估个性化、主动式的助手智能体一直很难，因为人在回路的实验耗时、花钱，还有伦理问题。传统 HCI 方法需要大量物理设备和真人参与，带来隐私顾虑，也限制了可扩展性。仿真环境能部分解决这些问题，但通常受限于规则化场景，交互引导和结果解读仍高度依赖人工。大语言模型的进展让生成式智能体可以模拟真实的人类行为、推理和社会动态，但它们在建模人机助手交互上的效果还缺乏研究。作者为此提出了一个生成式智能体仿真平台，专门模拟人与助手智能体的交互。他们挑选了十项覆盖交互设计不同方面的已有助手智能体研究，用该平台逐一复现。结果表明，用生成式智能体做的全仿真实验能近似还原人机助手交互的关键方面，并复现出原研究的核心结论。局限在于材料未说明仿真与原始人类数据的定量吻合程度。这项工作为研究助手智能体设计提供了可扩展、低成本、无需真人受试的方法。
9e231c2d620e6712.why: 它直接回答了做仿真推演的人最关心的问题：LLM 智能体仿真到底能不能替代真人实验。十项真实研究的复现是一个有说服力的检验方式，平台本身也可复用。

brief.question: 个性化、主动式助手智能体的设计评估依赖真人实验，耗时、成本高且有隐私和伦理问题，作者想验证生成式智能体仿真能否替代真人实验来研究人机助手交互设计。
brief.setup: 作者搭建了一个基于生成式智能体的人机助手交互仿真平台，复现了十项已有的助手智能体研究，这些研究覆盖交互设计的不同方面。材料未说明智能体数量、环境细节、时间尺度和使用的具体模型。
brief.method: 从文献中选出十项助手智能体研究，在仿真平台上逐一复现这些实验，用生成式智能体模拟人类被试与助手的交互。
brief.findings: 全仿真的生成式智能体实验能近似还原人机助手交互的关键方面，并复现出原研究的核心结论。材料未给出具体数字。
brief.validation: 与十项已发表的人类用户研究的核心结论对比，看仿真能否复现原结论。材料未说明复现的吻合程度等量化指标。
brief.limits: 材料未说明。
brief.reuse: 项目材料和资源公开在 https://dash-gidea.github.io/，仿真平台可用来在无真人被试的情况下研究助手智能体设计。

90d95cad3128e268.text: Modern transportation systems face pressing challenges due to increasing demand, dynamic environments, and heterogeneous information integration. The rapid evolution of Large Language Models (LLMs) offers transformative potential to address these challenges. Extensive knowledge and high-level capabilities derived from pretraining evolve the default role of LLMs as text generators to become versatile, knowledge-driven task solvers for intelligent transportation systems. This survey first presents LLM4TR, a novel conceptual framework that systematically categorizes the roles of LLMs in transportation into four synergetic dimensions: information processors, knowledge encoders, component generators, and decision facilitators. Through a unified taxonomy, we systematically elucidate how LLMs bridge fragmented data pipelines, enhance predictive analytics, simulate human-like reasoning, and enable closed-loop interactions across sensing, learning, modeling, and managing tasks in transportation systems. For each role, our review spans diverse applications, from traffic prediction and autonomous driving to safety analytics and urban mobility optimization, highlighting how emergent capabilities of LLMs such as in-context learning and step-by-step reasoning can enhance the operation and management of transportation systems. We further curate practical guidance, including available resources and computational guidelines, to support real-world deployment. By identifying challenges in existing LLM-based solutions, this survey charts a roadmap for advancing LLM-driven transportation research, positioning LLMs as central actors in the next generation of cyber-physical-social mobility ecosystems. Online resources can be found in the project page: https://github.com/tongnie/awesome-llm4tr.

997371afec02c161.text: Recent research shows that LLM Agents can generate ``believable'' human behaviors via prompt-only methods, and such agents have been increasingly adopted in downstream applications. However, existing evaluation of these agents only focuses on qualitative believability (whether human raters think they are accurate), leaving open questions of whether LLM agents can accurately generate step-by-step actions mimicking a particular human's behavior in a multi-turn interaction task. In this work, we take shopping as a case study and present the first large-scale quantitative evaluation of state-of-the-art LLMs' ability to accurately simulate human behavior. Using real-world data from 31,865 online shopping sessions containing 230,965 user actions, our evaluation reveals that prompt-based LLMs (DeepSeek-R1, Llama, Claude) achieve only 11.86% accuracy in generating human actions, highlighting a substantial gap in actual behavioral accuracy. Through experiments, we also showcase that strategies as simple as fine-tuning LLMs on real human click-through data augmented with synthesized reasoning traces can greatly enhance models' performance. The fine-tuned Qwen2.5-7B achieves 17.26% action generation accuracy and 33.86% F1 score on final purchase prediction, representing substantial improvements of 5.4% and 13.85% over prompt-only baselines. This work establishes the first rigorous benchmark for human behavior simulation and provides actionable insights for developing more accurate LLM agents for future downstream applications.
997371afec02c161.abstract_zh: 已有研究显示，纯提示方法就能让 LLM 智能体生成看起来可信的人类行为，这类智能体也被越来越多地用在下游应用里。但作者指出，现有评测只停留在定性层面，看人类评分者觉得像不像，没有回答 LLM 能否在多轮交互任务中逐步复现某个具体的人的行为。这篇论文以购物为案例，做了首个大规模定量评测。数据来自 31,865 个真实在线购物会话，共 230,965 条用户动作。评测结果显示，基于提示的 DeepSeek-R1、Llama、Claude 在生成人类动作上的准确率只有 11.86%，说明实际行为准确率存在很大缺口。作者进一步实验发现，用真实人类点击数据加上合成推理轨迹做微调，就能明显提升效果。微调后的 Qwen2.5-7B 动作生成准确率达到 17.26%，最终购买预测 F1 为 33.86%，分别比纯提示基线提高 5.4 和 13.85 个百分点。论文称这是首个严格的人类行为模拟基准，并为开发更准确的 LLM 智能体提供了可操作的启示。局限是准确率绝对值仍然很低，说明多轮行为模拟离可用还有距离。
997371afec02c161.why: 它给“LLM 能模拟人类行为”这个流行假设提供了反例：在真实购物数据上多轮动作准确率只有 11.86%，同时给出了一个可复用的定量评测基准和一条简单的改进路径。
